status.scope_reason: The company itself produces and commercially supplies lactoferrin ingredients as part of its specialized nutritional product line.
status.evidence: According to a Business Wire press release, Milk Specialties Global rebranded to Actus Nutrition in October 2024 and continues to supply bioactive ingredients including lactoferrin.

claims.claim: The company reports offering bovine lactoferrin within a wide range of concentration options extending from 0.15% purity up to 95% purity following a multimillion-dollar expansion at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility.

Product specifications from the company's official corporate ingredients brochure list a high-purity lactoferrin option at 95% concentration alongside multi-tier formulations containing 0.15%, 1%, 30%, and 45% lactoferrin.
claims.source: Milk Specialties Global Ingredients Brochure via Scribd

claims.claim: Milk Specialties Global (rebranded as Actus Nutrition) announced a multi-million-dollar investment at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility to begin commercial production of concentrated lactoferrin under its NutriPRO brand, which was completed in May 2021.

Actus Nutrition completed an expansion and modernization project at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility in August 2026, which added advanced manufacturing automation and robotics to enhance the operational scalability and production efficiency of its whey-based ingredients, including lactoferrin.
claims.corrected: Actus Nutrition completed an expansion and modernization project at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility in August 2026, which added advanced manufacturing automation and robotics to enhance the operational scalability and production efficiency of its whey-based ingredients, including whey powder.

claims.claim: The company (rebranded as Actus Nutrition) completed an expansion and infrastructure modernization project at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility in August 2026, which implemented process improvements and upgrades to drying operations and liquid management capabilities for processing specialty ingredients like lactoferrin.
claims.corrected: The company (rebranded as Actus Nutrition) completed an expansion and infrastructure modernization project at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility in August 2026, which implemented process improvements and upgrades to drying operations and liquid management capabilities for processing specialty ingredients like whey powder.

claims.claim: The company reports that its lactoferrin product line, marketed under its NutriPRO family of products, is supplied across a wide range of concentration options from a base level of 0.15% purity up to 95% purity.

The company's product portfolio includes bovine lactoferrin featuring a 90% protein level available in multiple concentration options of 0.15%, 1%, 30%, 45%, and 95%, as published in the Milk Specialties Global Ingredients Brochure.

claims.parameter: R&D and Clinical Evidence for Lactoferrin
claims.claim: The company reports the development and commercialization of its NutriPRO Lactoferrin ingredients following a multi-million dollar capital improvement project at its Fond Du Lac, Wisconsin facility to concentrate whey protein fractions into standard and high-purity (up to 95% purity) grades.
Actus Nutrition (formerly Milk Specialties Global) reports total annual corporate revenues of $1.5 billion following its rebranding announcement in October 2024.

The company announced its official entry into the lactoferrin market in May 2021 following a multimillion-dollar investment to initiate production at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin manufacturing facility.

Milk Specialties Global (rebranded as Actus Nutrition) stated that its multi-million-dollar investment completed in May 2021 to begin lactoferrin production at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility was executed in support of ongoing customer partnerships to align with their future supply chain needs.

The company's human nutrition division (Actus Nutrition) offers its NutriPRO Lactoferrin with both Kosher and Halal quality certifications, as documented by the U.S. Dairy Export Council's supplier directory.
claims.note: Quality certifications for NutriPRO Lactoferrin (specifically Kosher and Halal via the U.S. Dairy Export Council supplier directory) could not be verified in full context.

claims.claim: Actus Nutrition (formerly known as Milk Specialties Global) exports its dairy nutrition products, which include specialized lactoferrin manufactured at its Fond du Lac, Wisconsin facility, to customers in more than 50 countries.

The company maintains trade equivalency and organic handling certifications enabling international distribution across specific markets, including the European Union, the United Kingdom, Canada, and South Korea.
claims.note: Trade equivalency and specific international distribution organic handling certifications for EU, UK, Canada, and South Korea could not be confirmed.

claims.claim: Milk Specialties Global (which rebranded to Actus Nutrition in October 2024) is a privately held portfolio company of the private equity firm Butterfly Equity, which completed its acquisition of the company in February 2023.

In September 2024, the company secured a $300 million second lien term loan facility for a dividend recapitalization backed by its investor, Butterfly Equity, supporting its broad portfolio of value-added ingredients including lactoferrin.
